summary: Iteration 105 - Event Intelligence Integration into Market Robot & Smart Pricing Testing Complete. All 13 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI fully functional with event awareness in both Market Robot dashboard and Smart Pricing. Market Robot shows Event Days KPI (85 days), Robot Event Awareness panel with MEGA/LARGE badges, and supply trend chart with event badges. Smart Pricing shows Event Impact Days KPI (30 days), Event-Aware Smart Pricing Active banner, Price Evolution chart with red event dots and +X% labels, Recommendation Calendar with EVENT level, and AI Insights with 'Mega Events Detected (14 days)'.
